review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines restriction of right A∞ modules and module morphisms along an A∞ algebra morphism, plus the restriction functor on AInfinityRightModuleCat. Mathlib has no A∞ algebras or modules. A grep of Mathlib for `cofreeLift` and `class Comodule` found nothing, so the comodule infrastructure is not in Mathlib either. Mathlib's `ModuleCat.restrictScalars` and `Module.compHom` are restriction along ring homomorphisms, which is a different concept from A∞ morphisms. I read the private helpers `coactAlong` and `koszulTwist_comp_lTensor_coaugmentedBarMap` as local proof scaffolding, not independent concepts. I did not check the TauCeti-internal Comodule files, so I cannot rule out duplication there.
